title: LADM LA_Responsibility
description: A responsibility is a legally recognised obligation related to land (e.g. maintenance of a road, drainage duty, infrastructure upkeep). LA_Responsibility extends LA_RRR with rrrType fixed to 'responsibility' and adds optional duty payer/creditor party references.

allOf.$comment: CONSTRAINTS: Responsibility-specific rules and additional properties

type.description: LA_ResponsibilityType codelist. Common values: maintenanceDuty, paymentDuty, developmentDuty. Recommended scheme: LADM LA_ResponsibilityType or national equivalent.

dutyPayer.description: Typed reference to the party obligated to fulfil this responsibility (may differ from the general 'party' reference)

dutyCreditParty.description: Typed reference to the party that benefits from this responsibility being fulfilled
